services.name: Practice Snapshot
services.included: A first look at your website, Psychology Today profile and Google Business Profile, with your top three priorities, shared on our consult call.

services.name: Practice Growth Audit & Roadmap
services.included: Research on how clients find therapists in your market, a map of where your clients come from now, and a branded strategy deck with priorities in order, plus a walkthrough call.

services.name: Referral Partner Development
services.included: A prioritized list of local referral prospects, a structured outreach playbook, referral materials, a follow-up cadence, and employer and EAP partnership outreach. Ongoing outreach keeps the follow-up going for you.

services.name: Directory & Listings Management
services.small: $150 per profile; 3 profiles for $400; full listings package $600
services.large: $150 per profile; bundles quoted by number of clinicians
services.included: Choosing the right directories and rewriting and optimizing each profile. The full package adds an insurance directory check and claiming your Healthgrades and Zocdoc profiles.

services.name: Search Visibility: SEO + AI Search
services.included: Setup covers your Google Business Profile, consistent name, address and phone listings, schema, and two service and location pages. A full website rebuild is quoted separately. Monthly work adds pages, keeps listings current and tracks visibility in search and AI answers.

services.name: Paid Advertising
services.included: Choosing the right mix of Google, Meta and LinkedIn, ad copy, campaign setup and healthcare ad-policy compliance. Ad spend is separate and paid directly to the platforms.

services.name: Social Media & Content Strategy
services.included: A social audit with real numbers, content pillars, brand voice and bio rewrites, post concepts and calls to action.

services.name: Ongoing social media and content
services.included: Content development and management, scoped to your plan.

services.name: Monthly strategy retainer
services.included: A steady monthly rhythm: referral follow-up, listing upkeep and a check-in on what's working.

how: Every engagement begins with a free consult and Practice Snapshot. There's no obligation to do anything after it.
A written quote before any work.
You'll know exactly what's included and what it costs before you pay anything.
Small practice prices are for practices with 5 clinicians or fewer. Medium to large practice prices are for practices with 6 or more.
Paid Advertising fees cover setup and management. What you spend on Google, Meta or LinkedIn is paid directly to them.
Monthly services can be paused or stopped with notice.
Nothing I do asks your clients for reviews, uses their stories, or puts tracking on your site that could expose who's seeking care.
